goal: Rewrite the three weighting e2e specs to the post-JAA-425 flow (card click opens the detail/config modal; params + run button live in the modal; process close/open is on the status badge), so the smoke gate is green and no stale 'Configurar parametros' selectors remain.

new_flow_notes.card_open: Card is role=button (aria-label 'Abrir detalle de Pesaje para <label>'); clicking it opens WeightingDetailModal. No Ejecutar/Configurar/Ver detalle/Marcar buttons on the card.
new_flow_notes.params: Editable in the modal when process open + idle; controls labelled by raw key: combobox 'METODO_BOUNDS' (opt 'IQR'->iqr), number getByLabel('MAX_ROUNDS_COLAPSO'), switch 'CORRECAO_BOUNDS'. editableParams seeds from run.parameters_json merged over DEFAULT_WEIGHTING_PARAMS (so all 9 keys present); edits are modal-local (not persisted across close).
new_flow_notes.run: Modal run button 'Ejecutar' (no/failed run) / 'Re-ejecutar' (completed); opens an AlertDialog whose ACTION is labelled the same ('Ejecutar'/'Re-ejecutar', NOT 'Confirmar'); clicking it POSTs /weighting/runs(parameters=editableParams) and closes the modal.
new_flow_notes.process: Close/open via the ProcessStatusBadge button ('Abierto'/'Cerrado') -> AlertDialog action 'Cerrar proceso'/'Abrir proceso'. Default = open. When closed, the modal shows no run button.
new_flow_notes.history: Card 'Historial' icon button (title) still opens WeightingHistoryModal with per-row 'Ver detalle' (title) buttons.
